name: celltypepilot
description: Single-cell annotation trust layer — evidence-based cell-type labeling with an independent Annotation Critic. Parasitizes on your coding agent; no standalone app needed.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based single-cell annotation with independent critic review
interface.longDescription: CellTypePilot turns pre-clustered single-cell data into trusted, publication-ready cell-type annotations. It provides marker-based scoring across 80+ cell types and 11 tissues, an independent Annotation Critic that flags doubtful calls (evidence sufficiency, negative marker conflicts, doublet signals, ontology consistency), colorblind-friendly figures, and a draft methodology paragraph. The plugin parasitizes on your coding agent — no standalone app, no heavy infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: What cell types are in this h5ad?
